locals.sample_service_request_filter:
resource.type="k8s_container"
resource.labels.cluster_name="${var.gke_cluster_name}"
resource.labels.container_name="sample-service"
log_id("stdout")
jsonPayload.event="http_request"
jsonPayload.service="sample-service"
((resource.labels.namespace_name="dev" AND jsonPayload.environment="dev") OR (resource.labels.namespace_name="stage" AND jsonPayload.environment="stage") OR (resource.labels.namespace_name="prod" AND jsonPayload.environment="prod"))
(jsonPayload.health_check=true OR jsonPayload.health_check=false)
jsonPayload.status >= 100
jsonPayload.status < 600

sample_service_requests.name: sample_service_requests
sample_service_requests.description: Sample service HTTP responses, including health traffic.

labels.description: Target environment: dev, stage, or prod.
True only for requests handled by the exact GET health endpoint.

sample_service_errors.name: sample_service_errors
sample_service_errors.description: Sample service HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses, including health traffic.

labels.description: Target environment: dev, stage, or prod.
True only for requests handled by the exact GET health endpoint.

sample_service_latency.name: sample_service_latency_ms
sample_service_latency.description: Sample service server-side request handling duration in milliseconds.

labels.description: Target environment: dev, stage, or prod.
True only for requests handled by the exact GET health endpoint.
